journey.name: TL-08 The undo offer expires and the task stays deleted
journey.description:
Covers FR-12's default. Undo is an offer, not a confirmation dialog: a snackbar dismissed by timeout resolves to SnackbarResult.Dismissed, which routes to onMessageShown and clears the message without restoring anything (TaskListScreen.kt:177-181).
REGRESSION GUARD (issue #7). This journey failed on the build of 2026-09-08: the snackbar never expired at all. TaskListScreen called showSnackbar(message, actionLabel) without a duration, and Material3 reads an action label as a reason to default to SnackbarDuration.Indefinite - so the undo offer sat over the bottom of the list until it was tapped or swiped away, and TaskListUiState.message never returned to null. The duration is now stated rather than defaulted. Keep this journey: a future edit that drops the argument brings the defect straight back, and no unit test can see it, because the ViewModel was correct all along.
The dismissal is time-based rather than input-based, so this journey waits the snackbar out. SnackbarDuration.Long is about ten seconds; allow up to thirty before calling it a failure.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Tap the element with the content description "Delete task" on the "Book dentist" row
Verify that a message reading "Task deleted" is on screen
Wait for that message to disappear on its own without tapping "Undo"
Verify that "Task deleted" is no longer on screen
Verify that "Undo" is no longer on screen
Verify that "Book dentist" is not in the list
Verify that exactly three elements with the content description "Delete task" are on screen
